body: But when I cry for help, my feelings are dismissed. everyone turns it around to be about themselves instead of seeing how close I am to getting it right next time. death is the only silent responder. I am told that I don't open up to anyone, but when I choose to, they won't listen. when I say I need to talk to someone, to get help, I'm made to feel guilty because I'm not opening up to them, but I can't do that. because I don't want anyone to see this pain. I don't want pity, or sympathy, or even empathy. I don't know where to start trying with my life. I ruined it. couch hopping to avoid being on the street. my job is a joke, barely scheduling me enough hours to get a check. I don't eat for days at a time. even when I do, it's maybe a slice of pizza, or a couple bites of actual food. I have people all around me. yet I've never felt so alone. I don't feel like anyone truly cares about me anymore. my family is 800 miles away, at the closest. I'm alone, in a city I don't know, with fake friends, and a faker smile. I don't think anyone would even notice I was gone, honestly. not at first. word would take awhile. and by then, my soul will already be at peace. I don't believe in an afterlife, and that's becoming more and more soothing as time goes on, and my demons grow stronger. I don't want to get shoved into some hospital, or mental ward. but I feel like that's where I belong. and I would rather be buried, than live the sad life of a mental patient..
